verdict.rationale: Oyster's pricing page claims 'Automated expenses, time-off, and reports' and separately offers multi-country payroll, so it has some first-party time-off capability. Nothing documents PTO policy definition, accruals, approval workflows, or automatic flow of time off into payroll. Missing for 10: documented PTO policy configuration, accrual rules, time-off approval workflow, automatic payroll application of PTO, any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define PTO policies with accruals and approvals that apply automatically to payroll
